approach.mechanism: Basic Mobile IP registration plus a Return Routability exchange (home + care-of tokens) and an authenticated Binding Update to the correspondent, which then sends directly to the care-of address (IP-in-IP stand-in for the IPv6 routing header).
approach.name: Simplified route-optimisation model
approach.recovery_point: Binding Update accepted by the correspondent (route-optimised path active)
approach.scope_limits: The correspondent keeps using the old care-of address until the new binding is accepted, so handoff can be slower than via the home agent.
approach.status: SIMPLIFIED MODEL inspired by Mobile IPv6 route optimisation (RFC 6275). Route optimisation belongs to Mobile IPv6, not Mobile IPv4. This is NOT Mobile IPv6 and NOT a standards implementation (see app/mobileip/ro.py).

reason: ro-model in the loopback (real sockets) environment: needs routing and tunnels
